senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. זָוָוא) joint, angle, corner.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 31a:18">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>בז׳ זו</he> in one corner of the room, <he>בז׳ אחרת</he> in another corner; <cite ref="Pesachim 10b:2">Pes. 10ᵇ</cite>.—
M. Kat. 18ᵃ מז׳ לז׳ from one corner of the lips to the other (mustaches); a. fr.—קרן ז׳ (the horn of juncture), corner-piece, shelf.
<cite ref="Gittin 13a:6">Gitt. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>צבורין ומונחין בק׳ ז׳</he> heaped up and ready on the shelf; <cite ref="Kiddushin 66a:11">Kidd. 66ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>זָוִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 12:3">Neg. XII, 3</cite> <he>בשני כתלים בז׳</he> Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. sing.) on two adjoining walls; Sifra M’tsora, Neg., Par. 7, ch. V.
